mission: Make every Buddy capability measurable, guarded, and repairable by builder bots working benchmark gaps in parallel without duplicating ownership.
global_guardrails: never claim a feature is implemented or production-ready without repository and verification evidence
search for an existing canonical owner before creating a new bot, service, engine, workflow, policy, benchmark, or UI
extend existing systems instead of creating duplicate implementations whenever practical
generated plans, catalogs, buttons, routes, and filenames are not proof that runtime behavior works
keep failed, skipped, blocked, uncertain, and adapter-required verification visible
external writes require the correct authenticated adapter, permissions, and approval scope
paid actions require cost visibility and approval according to policy
user-owned and authorized data only; no silent private-app scraping or device-wide copying
local-first storage and processing where practical, with user-controlled export, delete, retention, and migration
high-impact or regulated decisions require appropriate human review and cannot be silently automated
never fabricate credentials, credits, reviews, awards, press, metrics, customers, followers, test results, or benchmark results
never guarantee income, fame, performance, approval, eligibility, rankings, business success, or investment results
do not imitate an unlicensed real person's voice or likeness or copy protected creative work
current-trend or competitor benchmarking measures observable characteristics and differentiated performance, not copying
untrusted repositories, models, files, and generated code must remain sandboxed until trust and security checks pass
secrets and credentials never belong in public files, logs, benchmark fixtures, or collection metadata
every destructive or irreversible action requires rollback, recovery, or explicit irreversible-action handling
every long-running or high-volume task must have resource, queue, retry, timeout, cancellation, and device-protection controls
phone/background execution must honor OS constraints, user permissions, thermal/network/battery policy, and kill switch
Buddy must remain transparent that it is AI and must not claim consciousness, human feelings, or fabricated shared history
personality adaptation must not become manipulation, dependency, coercion, deceptive persuasion, or hidden sensitive-trait inference
commercial media requires rights/provenance checks and synthetic-media labeling where required
builder bots may propose changes in parallel but must not merge conflicting ownership changes without reconciliation
issues close only after acceptance criteria and verification pass; history remains available for audit and learning

assignment_rules: group gaps that touch the same canonical owner or files into one lane
do not allow two lanes to edit the same canonical owner concurrently unless a reconciliation owner is declared
prefer the smallest change that closes multiple related benchmark gaps
do not weaken a guardrail to make a benchmark pass
do not mark a gap closed from static text/file matching alone
every fix must produce a retest result and comparison against baseline and target
regressions reopen the gap automatically in the generated report

close_conditions: implementation exists in the canonical owner
benchmark target passes or an owner-approved documented exception exists
the related issue or gap record links the verification evidence
